title: REBIND KEYS: SETTINGS, CHANGE KEYS
why: His order of 2026-10-13: put something in Settings where the player can remap keys. The Keys window (Settings, CHANGE KEYS) already took a click and a key press and swapped two actions that met; this finishes it. Every action now has its key and a REBIND control: click either, the key reads PRESS A KEY and the next press binds, ESC cancels. The actions sit in sections (MOVE, FIGHT, WORLD, PARTY) and the new keys are on the list, Q the crowbar and F the next gun among them. When a key is already used by another action the note under the title shows the clash and who moved where, and the two swap. ESC, TAB and P (pause), BACKSPACE, the key left of 1, 1 to 9, F9 and F11 keep their own jobs and cannot be rebound; P is off the list. The two side mouse buttons can be bound too, and an unbound side button keeps the browser back and forward. RESET TO DEFAULTS puts everything back. The map is kept in the profile and the key translation is rebuilt when a profile loads (it was left as it was), a map saved before the key swap starts again on the defaults once, and the full controls list, the Undercroft list and the controls hints now print the keys as set instead of the defaults. The controller layout never changes.
now: Settings, CHANGE KEYS now has a REBIND control on every action, shows a clash and swaps, keeps ESC and P, and takes the side mouse buttons.
